f831bc33: Who is the main hero of the Zelda games?
Link is the playable hero of every Zelda game, and players can often rename him. Zelda is the princess, and Ganon/Ganondorf the main villain.
186369e8: What is the Triforce in the Zelda universe?
A divine relic split into three triangles representing Power, Wisdom and Courage
The Triforce is the sacred relic left by the three Golden Goddesses, Nayru (Wisdom), Din (Power) and Farore (Courage). Ganondorf holds the Triforce of Power, Zelda Wisdom and Link Courage.
94e67ec0: What is the name of Link's legendary sword?
The Master Sword, the blade of evil's bane, is Link's iconic weapon: only the true hero can wield it. It often rests in the Sacred Grove or the Temple of Time.
04a0205e: Which Zelda game features Link as both a child and an adult?
Ocarina of Time (N64, 1998) is often called one of the greatest games of all time. Link travels through time between childhood and adulthood.
b24878c9: Which recurring enemy is the King of Evil in Zelda?
Ganondorf (his human form) or Ganon (his beast form) is the saga's main villain, a Gerudo king seeking the Triforce of Power to rule Hyrule.
78f90a63: Which musical instrument gives its name to the famous Zelda game released on Nintendo 64 in 1998?
The Ocarina of Time is the heart of the game: Link learns magical songs on it to travel through time, summon rain, call the sun and much more.
47431db5: Which Zelda game is set on Koholint Island?
In Link's Awakening (Game Boy, 1993), Link is shipwrecked on Koholint Island and must wake the Wind Fish to leave. Final twist: the whole island is a dream.
fbb12c4c: Which animal does Link turn into in Twilight Princess?
In Twilight Princess, Link turns into a wolf in the Twilight, guided by Midna, the Twilight Princess. Epona remains his faithful mare in the world of light.
74566f27: Which groundbreaking open-world Zelda came out in 2017 on Switch?
Breath of the Wild (2017) revolutionized the series: a huge open world, advanced physics, climbing on any surface and total freedom from the very start.
7bd5b911: Who is hiding behind Sheik in Ocarina of Time?
Sheik is Princess Zelda in disguise, hiding under this identity to guide Link during the seven years of Ganondorf's rule. The reveal is an iconic moment of the game.
c87f4f89: In which Zelda game does Link relive the same 3 days before a lunar disaster?
Majora's Mask (N64, 2000) is one of the darkest games in the series: Link must relive a 3-day loop to stop the Moon from crashing into Termina.
7d10416b: What is the name of the sequel to Breath of the Wild released in 2023?
Tears of the Kingdom (2023) is the direct sequel to BotW: Link must stop Ganondorf's return using new abilities (Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, Recall).
67236fb7: What is the name of Link's fairy companion in Ocarina of Time?
Navi is Link's guide fairy in OoT, famous for her endless “Hey! Listen!”, which became a meme. She helps Link target enemies and gives information.
712a818b: What is the first dungeon in Ocarina of Time?
The first dungeon is inside the Great Deku Tree, guardian of the forest. Link fights Queen Gohma there and obtains the Kokiri Emerald.
c7ad39ab: What does the name “Link” mean in the Zelda universe?
A link between the hero and the player
A link between past and future
A link between Hyrule and the shadow world
Link represents the link between the player and the game world, which is why he almost never speaks and can often be renamed.
3c608c8c: What is the ranged weapon Link uses most in the 3D games?
The bow and arrows are Link's iconic ranged weapon, present in almost every Zelda game since the first. In OoT, there are Fire, Ice and Light variants.
369c9b98: Which goddess created the Triforce of Courage in Zelda mythology?
Farore is the goddess of Courage, who created all life in Hyrule. Her Triforce stands for Courage, held by Link. Nayru gave Wisdom (Zelda) and Din Power (Ganondorf).
b82b719f: Which instrument does Link play in Majora's Mask?
Link uses the Ocarina of Time in Majora's Mask: Skull Kid steals it at the start and Link gets it back. Its songs control the 3-day cycle.
ca1f5328: Where does the final battle of Breath of the Wild take place?
Calamity Ganon has been held back inside Hyrule Castle by Zelda for 100 years. Link fights him there, then finishes the battle on the field against his beast form.
234c46dc: Which aquatic people live in Zora's Domain?
The Zoras are Hyrule's aquatic people, living in Zora's Domain and Lake Hylia. Ruto, the Zora princess, gives Link her Spiritual Stone and considers him her future husband.
22bba861: Which Zelda game first introduced the Triforce in gameplay?
In The Legend of Zelda (NES, 1986), the very first game, Link must gather the 8 fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom before facing Ganon.
d7d28020: What lets Link turn into a Deku, a Goron or a Zora in Majora's Mask?
Transformation masks are at the heart of Majora's Mask: the Deku Mask, Goron Mask and Zora Mask give Link different forms and abilities needed to progress.
c76343bc: Which new ability in Tears of the Kingdom lets Link pass through ceilings?
Ascend lets Link rise through any solid ceiling, a game-changer for vertical exploration, alongside Ultrahand (building) and Recall (rewinding).
ef1f6824: Which recurring character sells items to Link in many Zelda games?
Beedle is the recurring traveling merchant found in many Zelda games, selling arrows, bombs and useful items from his backpack or his airship.
b47af743: Which device does Link use in Breath of the Wild to activate his powers?
The Sheikah Slate is BotW's multi-purpose device: it takes photos and grants Magnesis, Stasis, Cryonis and Remote Bombs.
98c3e1cb: In which Zelda game are traditional dungeons largely replaced by 120 shrines?
Breath of the Wild (2017) replaces most traditional dungeons with 120 Shrines of Trials scattered across the world, each a self-contained puzzle rewarding a Spirit Orb.
0a7a2ddf: What is the name of the Kokiri village in Ocarina of Time?
Kokiri Forest is Link's home village in OoT, inhabited by the Kokiri, children who never grow up. Link lives there unaware that he is not a real Kokiri but a Hylian.
5e60d925: What is the name of the goddess of Wisdom in Zelda mythology?
Nayru is the goddess of Wisdom, who created the laws of the universe. Her Triforce stands for Wisdom, held by Zelda. Din is the goddess of Power (Ganondorf) and Farore of Courage (Link).
dd59ba5b: What is the name of the mask Skull Kid wears in Majora's Mask?
Majora's Mask is an evil artifact once used in rituals and sealed away because of its power. It possesses Skull Kid and pulls the Moon toward Termina.
98ecd5c7: Which recurring enemy swallows Link to steal his shield?
The Like Like is the tube-shaped enemy that swallows Link and steals his shield (or other gear in some games). You have to defeat it quickly to get your items back.
c71af49f: What is the name of the giant spider boss recurring in the Zelda series?
Gohma is a recurring boss since the first game. In Ocarina of Time, she guards the first dungeon and is fought by aiming at her single eye.
84a43c23: What is the name of the desert inhabited by the Gerudo in Ocarina of Time?
The Gerudo Desert (and Gerudo Valley) is the territory of the Gerudo warrior women. A single man is born among them every 100 years and becomes their king: Ganondorf was born there.
d2cd4857: What is the name of the all-female desert people in the Zelda saga?
The Gerudo are a people of warrior women living in the desert. Ganondorf (Ganon) was born a Gerudo.
dd6b6350: Which Ocarina of Time dungeon is famous for being the most dreaded by players?
OoT's Water Temple is widely cited as the series' most frustrating dungeon: its complex water-level mechanics and maze-like layout drove many players to despair.
aed5d93b: What does Link fly on in Skyward Sword?
Every resident of Skyloft has a Loftwing, a large bird used as a flying mount. Link's is a rare crimson one.
7799a8c9: What is the name of the ancient warrior tribe Impa belongs to in the Zelda series?
The Sheikah are an ancient tribe of shadow warriors who protect the Hylian royal family. Impa, Zelda's guardian, is one of them, and Zelda disguises herself as Sheik in OoT.
509e162e: What is the title of the first 3D Zelda game, released in 1998?
The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Zelda: A Link to the Past
Ocarina of Time (Nintendo 64, 1998) is the first 3D Zelda, often called one of the best games ever. It set the template for modern Zelda games with Z-targeting, time travel and the ocarina.
5db33f42: What are the small collectible creatures in Twilight Princess called?
Golden Bugs are Twilight Princess's collectibles: 24 golden insects hidden across Hyrule. Bringing them to Agitha, the self-proclaimed princess of bugs, earns bigger wallets.
c51a5709: Which special combat techniques does Link learn from the ghostly old hero in Twilight Princess?
The Hidden Skills are 7 techniques taught by the ghost of a former hero, the Hero's Shade: Ending Blow, Shield Attack, Back Slice, Helm Splitter, Mortal Draw, Jump Strike and Great Spin.
28ea2153: What is the name of the parallel world Midna comes from?
The Twilight Realm is the dark parallel dimension of Twilight Princess, and Midna is its exiled princess. Link turns into a wolf when he enters the Twilight.
4c1764d0: Who is the main antagonist of Majora's Mask?
Skull Kid, possessed by a mask
Skull Kid, possessed by Majora's Mask, is the antagonist: not Ganondorf, but a lonely forest imp who was once friends with the four Giants. Majora exploits his loneliness to corrupt him.
18f48440: In what chronological order are Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom set?
Breath of the Wild comes before Tears of the Kingdom: BotW ends with Calamity Ganon's defeat, and TotK begins afterward with the discovery of ruins beneath Hyrule Castle.
040d4bd7: What is the name of Skyward Sword's motion-controlled sword technique that fires a beam?
By raising the controller to the sky, Link charges his sword with energy and can fire a beam: the Skyward Strike, made possible by Wii MotionPlus.
06bb6cac: Who is Zelda in The Legend of Zelda series?
Zelda is the princess of the Kingdom of Hyrule, descended from the goddess Hylia, and holds the Triforce of Wisdom. Despite the title, Link is the playable hero.
89a8c318: How does the final battle of The Wind Waker end?
Link drives the sword into Ganondorf's forehead, turning him to stone
Zelda seals Ganon in a mirror
As the sea swallows Hyrule, Link drives the Master Sword into Ganondorf's forehead, and he turns to stone.
63e0a55a: How does Link travel between the islands in The Wind Waker?
On a talking boat, the King of Red Lions
Link sails on the King of Red Lions, a talking boat revealed to be the King of Hyrule. The Wind Waker baton lets him control the wind.
3f194618: Who is the main enemy of A Link to the Past?
In A Link to the Past (SNES), Agahnim is the evil wizard who breaks the seal, and is revealed to be Ganon's alter ego in the Light World. Ganon himself is defeated in the Dark World.
0b47a303: Where does Link find the Master Sword in Ocarina of Time?
Link draws the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Temple of Time and wakes up seven years later. Returning it sends him back to the past.
de66fc48: What is Link's legendary spinning attack, used in almost every Zelda game?
The Spin Attack lets Link strike all around him by charging his sword and whirling. It has been a series staple since A Link to the Past.
af2d0f27: Which heart-shaped healing item is the most common in Zelda dungeons?
Recovery Hearts are found in grass, pots and chests and restore some health. Heart Containers permanently increase Link's maximum health.
ee46c36e: Which ability introduced in Tears of the Kingdom lets Link join and move objects to build structures?
Ultrahand (introduced in Tears of the Kingdom, not BotW) lets Link stick objects together. In BotW, the closest equivalents were Magnesis (moving metal objects) and Stasis (freezing objects).
9fb7638d: What is the name of Skyward Sword's main antagonist, before Ganondorf exists?
Demise is Skyward Sword's primordial demon, whose hatred is reborn again and again as Ganondorf. His curse on Link and Zelda explains the endless cycle of the series.
3aa18d85: In what form does Ganon appear at the end of A Link to the Past and Ocarina of Time?
Ganon, Ganondorf's beast form, is a colossal boar-headed monster wielding a trident or blades.
c6b2659c: Which merchant island in The Wind Waker has shops and an auction house?
Windfall Island is The Wind Waker's big trading port, with shops, an auction house and lots of residents. Link's home island is Outset Island.
00880c87: Where does Link get his first powers in Breath of the Wild?
In the Divine Beast Vah Medoh
In the shrines of the Great Plateau
On the Great Plateau, Link explores four shrines that give him his first powers: Magnesis, Stasis, Cryonis and Remote Bombs.
288bf882: Which Tears of the Kingdom ability lets Link pass through solid ceilings?
Ascend lets Link rise through any solid ceiling, a game-changer for vertical exploration, alongside Ultrahand (building) and Recall (rewinding).
c88fd74d: What is the final dungeon of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past (SNES)?
Ganon's Tower, atop Death Mountain in the Dark World, is the last dungeon. Link defeats Agahnim there before facing Ganon in the Pyramid.
25720091: According to Skyward Sword, which goddess was reborn as Princess Zelda?
Skyward Sword reveals that the goddess Hylia was reborn as a mortal, Zelda, to help the hero defeat Demise.
fb1453fa: What is Ganondorf's main target in Ocarina of Time to obtain the Triforce?
The Temple of Time and the Spiritual Stones
Ganondorf wants the 3 Spiritual Stones that open the Door of Time, leading to the Sacred Realm and the Triforce. He lets Link do the work, then follows him in.
d7ef3608: Which town in Breath of the Wild does Link have to sneak into in disguise?
Gerudo Town is BotW's women-only town (men are not allowed in), so Link must disguise himself as a Gerudo woman to enter and progress toward Vah Naboris.
12d11c34: Who is the Sage of Water in Ocarina of Time?
Ruto, princess of the Zoras, becomes the Sage of Water. Ever since Link rescued her inside Jabu-Jabu's belly, she has considered him her fiancé.
748727a1: Which ability of his sword helps Link locate objects or people in Skyward Sword?
With Dowsing, Link points his sword and follows a signal that guides him to the object or person he is looking for.
